title: hypochaeris microcephala var. albiflora
intro: Hypochaeris microcephala var. albiflora, commonly known as a variety of the small-leaved cat's ear plant, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hypochaeris microcephala var. albiflora include its ability to stimulate the liver and gallbladder, promote the removal of waste products, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
